bibl.title: The format, layout and provenance of documents pertaining to liturgy
bibl.seg: Paul Schubert, The Format, Layout and Provenance of Documents Pertaining to Liturgy.
Pylon. Editions and Studies of Ancient Texts 1 (2022) §1-30, figg.
bibl.note: Introduction. - The corpus of approvals of nomination to liturgy (προγράμματα). - Layout: from nomination to liturgy to approval of nomination. - Format: demotic style vs. pagina. - The Arsinoite nome: a special case? - Data pertaining to nominations, approvals and oaths (2nd - 3rd c. CE). - Conclusion.
